claim: RecA forms a helical filament on single stranded DNA during homologous recombination
source_text: During homologous recombination, RecA forms a helical filament on a single stranded (ss) DNA that searches for a homologous double stranded (ds) DNA and catalyzes the exchange of complementary base pairs to form a new heteroduplex.
evidence_reasoning: This is established scientific knowledge about RecA function in homologous recombination.
